title: The Corinthian Maid
alt: In a dimly lit room, a barefoot young woman in a dark yellow dress leans one knee on a wooden chair and reaches out with a stylus to trace the shadow of a sleeping young man on the brown wall behind him. He wears a yellow tunic and a blue cloak, a spear rests on his shoulder and a thin dog sleeps at his side. A deep red curtain in the upper left corner hides the light, which falls from over our left shoulder.

title: Allegory of Virtue and Vice
alt: A landscape divided by a broken tree trunk with one green shoot. On the right a smiling satyr, half man and half goat, reclines on grass and peers into a golden urn, with a stormy sea and a sinking ship behind him. On the left a pale child crouches on stony ground among a compass, books, a square, a flute, pan pipes and a scroll, and a small winged figure climbs a path towards the clouds.

title: Vista from a Grotto
alt: The round mouth of a craggy cave nearly fills a square painting. Tan and brown rocks rise like cliffs on each side, a wooden cross leans on a rock at lower left, and a winding turquoise stream runs out through the opening to blue water, white mountains and a pearly white sky, with birds far off.

title: A City of Fantasy
alt: An imaginary city of buildings and towers on rolling green hills around a light grey stretch of water. Sailing ships glide on a wide waterway that divides into three rivers crossed by many bridges. Some buildings look like medieval fortresses, others like modern skyscrapers, and the most distant ones rest on grey and blue clouds under a pale yellow sky.
